name: EPIC 220289856
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 8, 10.9 solar radii and 0.96 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 4,406 parsecs away, 11 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 8, give 0.96 solar masses and 10.9 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,787 K at its surface.
